_meta.description: Frozen field definitions for the dual-LLM extraction pipeline. Each field specifies meaning, allowed values, units, and what constitutes a material disagreement between models.

syndicate.allowed_values: Any valid Lloyd's syndicate number (2-5 digits)

year.description: Financial year-end of the report (calendar year of 31 December year-end)

opening_reserves_gbp_m.description: Opening gross claims outstanding (gross claims reserves) at start of the financial year. This is ONLY claims reserves -- excludes unearned premium provisions. Sourced from Balance Sheet or Technical Reserves note.
opening_reserves_gbp_m.units: millions in native currency (GBP, USD, or EUR as per report)
opening_reserves_gbp_m.allowed_values: Positive number or null if not found
opening_reserves_gbp_m.material_disagreement: Relative difference > 0.5% or absolute difference > 0.05m, unless one is null and other is 0.0

prior_year_development_gbp_m.description: Prior year reserve development amount. Sourced from 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note or explicit narrative text quantifying the prior year release/strengthening. NOT from the Technical Reserves reconciliation table (which includes current year movements).
prior_year_development_gbp_m.units: signed millions in native currency: NEGATIVE = release (reserves were sufficient, surplus returned), POSITIVE = strengthening (reserves were insufficient, additional provision needed)
prior_year_development_gbp_m.allowed_values: Signed number or null if not found
prior_year_development_gbp_m.material_disagreement: Any sign disagreement, or magnitude difference > 0.5% relative / 0.05m absolute

prior_year_development_pct.description: Prior year development as percentage of opening gross claims outstanding
prior_year_development_pct.units: signed percentage: NEGATIVE = release, POSITIVE = strengthening
prior_year_development_pct.allowed_values: Signed number or null if not calculable

direction.description: Overall direction of prior year reserve movement
direction.material_disagreement: Any difference (except release vs mixed or strengthening vs mixed when components go both ways)

exact_reserve_text.description: Verbatim sentence(s) from the document describing the prior year reserve movement
exact_reserve_text.material_disagreement: Not material -- text differences are tolerated

primary_causes.description: Causal factors mapped to standard causal categories
primary_causes.allowed_values: Standard causal category names from CAUSAL_CATEGORIES list

specific_events.description: Named events mentioned in context of reserve movements

specific_years_affected.description: Prior accident years mentioned as affected by reserve movements

prior_year_events.description: Structured list of named events from prior years affecting reserves
prior_year_events.allowed_values: Objects with event_name, event_year, impact_description, lobs_affected, amount_gbp_m, confidence

named_events.description: All named catastrophe events, large losses, and significant incidents mentioned anywhere in the document
named_events.allowed_values: Objects with event_name, event_year, event_type, net_loss_gbp_m, loss_description, lobs_affected, page, confidence

standardized_narrative.description: One paragraph summary of the reserve movement, causes, and affected lines

raw_causal_phrases.description: Verbatim causal phrases from the document

lob_movements.description: Reserve movements broken down by line of business
lob_movements.allowed_values: Objects with line_of_business (standard Lloyd's LOB name), direction, amount_gbp_m (signed), percentage, confidence
lob_movements.material_disagreement: Not material -- differences tolerated (LOB granularity varies by report)

gross_premiums_written_gbp_m.description: Total gross premiums written for the year

gross_premium_mix.description: Gross premium breakdown by regulatory/statutory class from the Segmental Analysis note. Uses EXACT class names as printed (not mapped to standard Lloyd's LOBs). When report has separate Direct and Reinsurance acceptances sub-tables, individual direct categories are listed plus one consolidated 'Reinsurance acceptances' total.
gross_premium_mix.allowed_values: Objects with line_of_business (verbatim regulatory class name), amount_gbp_m, percentage_of_total
gross_premium_mix.material_disagreement: Missing or extra non-zero LOB entries; amount differences > 0.5% relative. Zero-amount entries and subtotal rows are not material.

currency.description: Reporting currency of the financial statements

data_quality_notes.description: Caveats about data availability or extraction uncertainty
